title: Dashboard
description: What needs attention in the laboratory today, and the next step to take.

nextStep.heading: Next best step
nextStep.allClearBody: No units on hold, no failed or inconclusive tests, no open incidents, nothing in transit and no experiment close to its end date.

failedTests.title: Review {count, plural, one {# failed lab test} other {# failed lab tests}}
failedTests.why: A failed result places its unit on hold. Record the decision before the material moves.

onHold.title: Review {count, plural, one {# unit on hold} other {# units on hold}}
onHold.why: Held units cannot be moved, derived, shipped or destroyed until a quality decision releases them.

openIncidents.title: Close out {count, plural, one {# open incident} other {# open incidents}}
openIncidents.why: Open incidents need an investigation and a recorded resolution.

overdueExperiments.title: Close out {count, plural, one {# experiment past its end date} other {# experiments past their end date}}
overdueExperiments.why: These experiments have ended but still hold material in inventory. Ship it, destroy it or extend the experiment.

inconclusiveTests.title: Resolve {count, plural, one {# inconclusive lab test} other {# inconclusive lab tests}}
inconclusiveTests.why: An inconclusive result is neither a pass nor a fail. Retest, or record the decision.

inTransit.title: Follow up {count, plural, one {# shipment in transit} other {# shipments in transit}}
inTransit.why: Record the delivery once the receiving licence holder confirms it.

endingSoonExperiments.title: Plan for {count, plural, one {# experiment ending within {days} days} other {# experiments ending within {days} days}}
endingSoonExperiments.why: Decide what happens to the remaining material before each experiment ends.

attention.heading: Needs attention
attention.description: Each row opens the matching list.

onHold.label: Units on hold
onHold.hint: Quality hold or quarantine. Movement is blocked.

failedTests.label: Failed lab tests
failedTests.hint: Each failure holds its unit until a decision is recorded.

openIncidents.label: Open incidents
openIncidents.hint: Not yet closed with a resolution.

inTransit.label: Shipments in transit
inTransit.hint: Waiting for delivery to be recorded.

experiments.heading: Running experiments
experiments.description: {count, plural, one {# experiment} other {# experiments}} in progress
experiments.units: {count, plural, one {# unit in inventory} other {# units in inventory}}
experiments.emptyBody: Start an experiment to begin registering units.

recent.heading: Recent activity
recent.auditDescription: The latest entries in the audit trail.
recent.emptyBody: Activity appears here as soon as someone registers or changes a unit.

inventory.heading: Inventory snapshot
inventory.description: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} in inventory now. Bars are proportional to the number shown.
inventory.emptyBody: Units appear here once an experiment registers or receives material.
inventory.otherLocations: {locations, plural, one {# other location} other {# other locations}}

charts.heading: Overview
charts.description: The inventory and the lab in pictures. Every figure is also written out.

location.title: Units by location
location.description: Bars show how full a location is where it has a capacity.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Everything recorded in the lab over the last {days} days: unit changes, tests, shipments and incidents.
